why: Public v1.2.2 removes DCM opening and registration from the viewer and Explorer DLL, in addition to encrypted HPS decryption and all embedded/environment key loading. This source revision includes all removals. Explorer lifecycle validation is pending; do not ship the previous pin.
retire_when: The shell built from the current tree has been used in Explorer on a real machine through the thumbnail, preview-pane, file-association and uninstall paths, and nothing in the pin-to-HEAD delta for the crates above is still wanted.
backport: Any future shell pin must retain the removal of DCM support, encrypted HPS decryption, and all embedded/environment key loading. Exercise thumbnail, preview-pane, file-association and uninstall paths in Explorer before recording a revision as verified.
check: scripts/report-shell-pin.sh writes the delta between this revision and the tree being released; the release records it as dist/occluview-shell-revision.json.
